groups.title: Transformer Testing
groups.summary: Oil-filled and dry-type transformers, instrument transformers and field assembly.
groups.intro: Oil-filled and dry-type transformers get the same core set of checks: polarization index, turns ratio, winding resistance and a visual inspection. Oil-filled units add power factor, oil sample analysis and a mechanical inspection, and device testing is included where the transformer carries devices.
groups.imageAlt: A large power transformer set on its pad inside a shop building

services.title: Oil-Filled Transformer Testing
services.text: The full test set for oil-filled units, from the electrical measurements through to the oil itself.

services.title: Dry Type Transformer Testing
services.text: Dry type units tested on the measurements that matter without any oil work.

services.title: Instrument Transformer Testing
services.text: The smaller transformers that metering, protection and control depend on.

services.title: Transformer Assembly
services.text: Transformer assembly on site, one of the five areas of work we show in our gallery.

groups.title: Switchgear & Breakers
groups.summary: Circuit breakers, switches, switchgear, surge arrestors and busway, from low voltage to high.
groups.intro: We test the switching and protection side of a distribution system across all voltage levels. Contact resistance and insulation resistance run through every device, with dielectric withstand, fuse resistance, trip testing and the integrity checks each type of interrupter calls for.
groups.imageAlt: A line-up of switchgear and control panels at a plant

services.title: Circuit Breaker Testing
services.text: Air, insulated-case and molded-case breakers tested on contact resistance, insulation resistance and a time overcurrent pick-up and trip test by primary or secondary injection, plus device testing and a visual inspection.
points: Medium voltage air circuit breaker testing
Medium to high voltage oil circuit breaker testing
Medium voltage vacuum circuit breaker testing
Medium voltage SF₆ circuit breaker testing

services.title: Switch Testing
services.text: Every switch type we test takes contact resistance, insulation resistance and a visual inspection, with the integrity check its interrupter calls for: vacuum bottle, gas bottle, SF₆ gas sample or oil sample analysis.
points: Low voltage air switch testing, with ground fault testing
Medium to high voltage air switch testing

services.title: Switchgear & Surge Arrestors
services.text: Switchgear and the surge protection around it, at every voltage level.
points: Low, medium and high voltage switchgear testing
Low, medium and high voltage surge arrestor testing

services.title: Metal Enclosed Busway Testing
services.text: Busway runs checked end to end before they carry load.

groups.title: Cable Testing
groups.summary: Medium and high voltage cable, and low voltage cable to 600V.
groups.intro: Cable faults are found before they find you. Medium and high voltage runs take very low frequency testing, either VLF withstand or VLF tan delta, together with continuity, insulation and partial discharge work. Low voltage cable takes the shorter set.
groups.imageAlt: Shielded cable terminations landed inside an enclosure

services.title: Medium to High Voltage Cable Testing
services.text: The full diagnostic set for medium and high voltage cable.
points: Very low frequency testing, VLF withstand or VLF tan delta

services.title: Low Voltage Cable Testing
services.text: Cable rated to 600V maximum, checked before it is energized.

groups.title: Transformer Oil Processing
groups.summary: Vacuum filling, filtration, dehydration, degassing and hot-oil processing in the field.
groups.intro: Transformer oil is processed on site, on new installations and on units already in service. The work covers vacuum filling, filtration and purification, moisture and dissolved gas removal, circulation and heating, and the sampling and testing that says when it is done.
groups.imageAlt: Oil processing equipment and totes alongside a unit being set by crane

services.title: Vacuum Filling & Field Processing
services.text: New transformers filled and processed in the field, and existing ones processed on maintenance.

services.title: Filtration & Dehydration
services.text: Contamination, moisture and dissolved gas taken out of the oil.

services.title: Hot-Oil Processing
services.text: Circulation, heating and transfer, with storage handled as part of the job.

services.title: Oil Sampling & Testing
services.text: Transformer oil sampling and testing, so the condition of the oil is a reading rather than a guess.

groups.title: Commissioning & Field Solutions
groups.summary: Commissioning, maintenance testing, relay, battery and motor work, and field solutions for wildlife and strain relief.
groups.intro: Beyond the test set, we commission new installations and carry out the maintenance testing that keeps existing ones in service. The same crews handle protective relays, station batteries, motors and contactors, and the field solutions that protect equipment once it is running.
groups.imageAlt: A skid-mounted electrical building being lifted into place at site

about.title: A new company, built on years already spent in the field.
text: After years of dedication and hard work, a new venture has emerged in the electrical services industry. Powre Tek Electrical Field Services is the culmination of years spent honing skills and mastering the intricacies of electrical work. The founders, driven by a shared dream and passion, realized that it was time to turn their long-held vision into reality.

The founders bring a collective 35 years of experience in electrical services. That background covers a wide range of work, including electrical testing and inspections, with safety and efficiency prioritized at every step.
The company is based in Alvin, Texas, and the work travels. Depending on the role and the project, team members go throughout the United States and internationally.

facts.heading: Electrical Testing & Maintenance
facts.text: We specialize in advanced electrical testing and diagnostics for transformers, switchgear and power distribution systems. Our certified technicians use industry-standard equipment and proven testing methods to ensure reliability, safety and compliance across all voltage levels.
